zh:
当 Skill 超过 100 个，问题不再是“Prompt 怎么写”，而是 Retrieval + Classification + Policy Routing + Governance。把所有 Skill 塞进 Prompt 会带来：Token 成本 · 延迟 · 注意力稀释 · 位置偏差 · 描述冲突 · 未授权能力暴露。Skill 越多，没有治理命中率可能越低。

Capability Architecture：Skill、Workflow、MCP 与 Tool 各自在哪一层 §6.A

这一章不只是“如何选 Skill”。生产系统还要区分能力契约、控制流程、协议接入和真实副作用执行；否则很容易把 Skill、MCP、Function Calling 和 Tool 混成同一层。

FIG.6.A1 · CAPABILITY ARCHITECTURE

从业务意图到真实执行：五层能力栈

上层决定“应该做什么”，下层负责“通过什么协议、由谁真正执行”；授权与验证贯穿边界。

LAYER 1

Business Goal / User Intent

目标、风险、当前状态、用户权限决定需要哪类能力。
LAYER 2

Skill Contract / Capability Registry

when_to_use · when_not_to_use · inputs/outputs · permission · risk · owner · version
LAYER 3

Workflow / State Machine / Policy Gate

决定执行顺序、缺失输入、审批、重试、停止和恢复；Skill 不等于一个裸 Tool Call。
LAYER 4

MCP / Function Calling / API Interface

负责 capability exposure、schema、discovery、transport 或 structured action proposal；它们不是最终业务授权。
LAYER 5

Host Execution → Tool / API / DB / Service

Host 做 schema validation、authorization、idempotency、timeout、logging，并承担真实副作用。
边界原则

Protocol exposes capabilities; Skill defines reusable task procedure; Workflow controls execution; Host owns authority and side effects.

Positive examples improve recall; hard negatives improve boundaries.

TypeSafe primitives

Intent Routing：不要让一种机制吃掉全部流量 §6.B

生产级意图识别不是“规则还是大模型”的二选一，而是按置信度、任务复杂度、风险与成本逐层升级。便宜且确定的请求应尽早退出；只有真正模糊或组合式任务才进入高成本 planner。

FIG.6.B1 · COST-AWARE ROUTING CASCADE

从确定性 Fast Path 到结构化 Planner

每一层都必须有置信度出口；不确定性进入下一层，而不是被强行分类。

INPUT

User Turn + State

先更新 current task、active entity、filled slots、corrections 与 topic-scoped state。
FAST PATH

Deterministic Gate

Exact mapping · regex · FSM · typed command。只接稳定、低歧义、高置信边界。
CONTEXT

State-aware Router

Referent resolution · continuation/topic shift · lightweight classifier / semantic match · confidence gate。
ESCALATE

Structured LLM Planner

处理 ambiguous / compositional / multi-step 请求；输出 typed capability/tool proposal，而不是只猜一个 Intent label。
CONTROL

Permission · Risk · Input Gate → Host

Capability match 之后仍需 authorization、schema、approval、idempotency 与 result validation；Host 才拥有真实执行权。
升级原则

Escalate by uncertainty, task complexity, and risk—not by a fixed technology ladder.

FIG.6.B1A · ROUTING FUNNEL ECONOMICS

越往下流量越少，歧义、复杂度和单请求成本越高

漏斗不是为了强行追求某个流量比例，而是让简单稳定的问题尽早退出，把昂贵推理预算留给真正需要它的长尾请求。

L1 · WIDE

Deterministic Fast Path

高频 · 低歧义 · 低单位成本。只收 stable command / regex / FSM / typed action，不把边缘例外不断塞进规则库。
L2 · CORE

Context-aware Router

承担主要常规语义流量。依赖 state freshness、referent resolution、continuation/topic shift 与轻量 classifier / semantic match。
L3 · NARROW

Structured LLM Planner

低流量 · 高歧义 · 高单位成本。用于 cross-domain、compositional、multi-step 和 dynamic tool choice，输出结构化 capability / tool proposal。
方向 L1 L2 L3
Traffic sharehighmediumlow
Ambiguitylowmediumhigh

Unit latency / costlowmediumhigh
ANTI-PATTERN

Rule Black Hole

每个新边缘案例都变成 regex / exception，最终产生 precedence、conflict、test surface 与 ownership debt。
ANTI-PATTERN

LLM Front Door

所有请求默认先走最昂贵模型，导致不必要的 latency、cost 和 output variance，并把确定性问题也暴露给概率模型。
漏斗原则

Reduce average decision cost without hiding uncertainty or turning the fast path into a rule warehouse.

System-One Decision Models：把 Jev 放进 Routing Cascade §6.C

Jev 更适合被理解为一种 typed probabilistic decision layer，而不是更小的聊天模型。它处理答案空间预先定义的 Noul / Choice / Score 决策；开放式生成、复杂规划和多步推理继续交给 System-Two LLM。

FIG.6.C1 · SYSTEM-ONE + SYSTEM-TWO

快决策负责封闭判断，慢推理负责开放任务

这不是模型代际替换，而是把不同任务形状放进不同执行层。

STATE

User / Program State

自然语言、结构化业务状态、Agent trace 或其他待判断输入。
SYSTEM ONE

Typed Probabilistic Decisions

Noul · Choice · Score
输出预定义类型、概率与 confidence，适合 classify / route / score / gate。
GATE

Confidence + Policy

高置信、低风险可以直接分支；低置信、缺信息或高风险进入 clarify / review / escalation。
SYSTEM TWO

General LLM Planner

开放式生成、组合意图、多步骤规划、代码与报告等不能提前枚举答案空间的任务。
CONTROL

Authorization · Validation · Host

无论哪种模型作出决策，真实副作用仍由权限、schema、审批、验证和 Host 控制。
架构原则

Closed decision → typed probabilistic fast path. Open reasoning → general planner.

FIG.6.C2 · DECISION PRIMITIVES

三种 primitive 对应三种可编程决策形状

Primitive 输出 适合
Noul命题为真的概率 [0,1]；阈值决定 yes/norisk gate · condition · escalation

Scorescale rating + level distribution + confidencequality · risk · priority · relevance
关键边界

Type-safe ≠ semantically correct. 输出不会跑出 schema，不代表业务判断一定正确；confidence calibration、fallback、slice eval 与高风险人工复核仍然需要。

维度 System-One / Jev-shaped General LLM / System-Two-shaped
答案空间预定义、typed开放文本 / 代码 / 计划
核心动作classify · choose · score · gategenerate · reason · synthesize · plan
主要优势直接进入代码分支；显式概率 / confidence表达能力强；能处理开放和组合任务
主要限制无法自由生成任意内容延迟 / 成本更高，输出自由度增加验证负担

截至 2026-09-23，Jev 仍为 TypeSafe early access。其速度与成本优势来自 TypeSafe 公布的 System-One-shaped workflow 评测，应视为 vendor benchmark，而不是通用 SLA。生产选型仍应在自己的数据上测 accuracy、calibration、P50/P95、cost/success 与 downstream task success。
en:
When the number of Skills exceeds 100, the problem is no longer “how should the Prompt be written,” but Retrieval + Classification + Policy Routing + Governance. Putting every Skill into the Prompt causes Token cost · latency · attention dilution · position bias · description conflicts · exposure of unauthorized capabilities. As the number of Skills grows, hit rate can actually decline without governance.

Capability Architecture: where Skill, Workflow, MCP, and Tools belong §6.A

This chapter is not only about selecting a Skill. A production system must separate capability contracts, control flow, protocol access, and real side-effect execution; otherwise Skill, MCP, function calling, and tools collapse into one ambiguous layer.

FIG.6.A1 · CAPABILITY ARCHITECTURE

From business intent to real execution: a five-layer capability stack

Upper layers decide what should be done; lower layers define how capability access is exposed and who actually executes it. Authorization and validation cross every boundary.

LAYER 1

Business Goal / User Intent

Goal, risk, current state, and user permissions determine which capability is needed.
LAYER 2

Skill Contract / Capability Registry

when_to_use · when_not_to_use · inputs/outputs · permission · risk · owner · version
LAYER 3

Workflow / State Machine / Policy Gate

Controls execution order, missing inputs, approvals, retries, stopping, and recovery. A Skill is not a raw tool call.
LAYER 4

MCP / Function Calling / API Interface

Provides capability exposure, schemas, discovery, transport, or structured action proposals; these are not the final business-authorization decision.
LAYER 5

Host Execution → Tool / API / DB / Service

The host performs schema validation, authorization, idempotency, timeouts, and logging, and owns real side effects.
Boundary rule

Protocol exposes capabilities; Skill defines reusable task procedure; Workflow controls execution; Host owns authority and side effects.

2026-09-28 · Verification boundaries

The Skill Contract is a business registry proposal, not a universal SKILL.md schema. A 429 response may be retried according to Retry-After. Noul is an official name and returns a probability in [0,1]; policy supplies the yes/no threshold. Jev performance claims remain vendor-reported, not independently reproduced.

TypeSafe primitives

Intent Routing: do not make one mechanism handle all traffic §6.B

Production intent recognition is not a rules-versus-LLM choice. Escalate by confidence, task complexity, risk, and cost. Cheap deterministic requests should exit early; only ambiguous or compositional tasks should reach the expensive planner.

FIG.6.B1 · COST-AWARE ROUTING CASCADE

From deterministic fast paths to a structured planner

Every layer needs an uncertainty exit. Unresolved requests escalate instead of being forced into a label.

INPUT

User Turn + State

Update current task, active entity, filled slots, corrections, and topic-scoped state first.
FAST PATH

Deterministic Gate

Exact mapping · regex · FSM · typed command. Admit only stable, low-ambiguity, high-confidence boundaries.
CONTEXT

State-aware Router

Referent resolution · continuation/topic shift · lightweight classifier / semantic match · confidence gate.
ESCALATE

Structured LLM Planner

Handles ambiguous, compositional, and multi-step requests; emits typed capability/tool proposals rather than only guessing an intent label.
CONTROL

Permission · Risk · Input Gate → Host

Capability matching is followed by authorization, schema checks, approvals, idempotency, and result validation. The host owns real execution authority.
Escalation rule

Escalate by uncertainty, task complexity, and risk—not by a fixed technology ladder.

FIG.6.B1A · ROUTING FUNNEL ECONOMICS

As requests move down the funnel, traffic falls while ambiguity, complexity, and per-request cost rise

The funnel is not about forcing a target traffic percentage. It lets simple, stable requests exit early and reserves expensive reasoning budget for the long tail that actually needs it.

L1 · WIDE

Deterministic Fast Path

High-volume, low-ambiguity, low unit cost. Admit stable commands, regex/FSM, and typed actions without endlessly encoding edge cases into the rule set.
L2 · CORE

Context-aware Router

Handles most routine semantic traffic. Quality depends on state freshness, referent resolution, continuation/topic-shift detection, and lightweight classification or semantic matching.
L3 · NARROW

Structured LLM Planner

Low-volume, high-ambiguity, high unit cost. Use for cross-domain, compositional, multi-step, and dynamic-tool-choice requests, producing structured capability or tool proposals.
Dimension L1 L2 L3
Traffic sharehighmediumlow
Ambiguitylowmediumhigh

ANTI-PATTERN

Rule Black Hole

Every new edge case becomes another regex or exception, creating growing precedence, conflict, test-surface, and ownership debt.
ANTI-PATTERN

LLM Front Door

Every request starts with the most expensive model, adding unnecessary latency, cost, and output variance while exposing deterministic problems to probabilistic behavior.
Funnel rule

Reduce average decision cost without hiding uncertainty or turning the fast path into a rule warehouse.

FIG.6.B2 · ROUTING DECISION BOUNDARIES

Intent, capability, and authorization are three different decisions

1

Intent Understanding

What is the user trying to achieve? Does this turn depend on prior state, entities, or slots?
2

Capability Routing

Which Skill, Workflow, or Tool combination can satisfy the goal? Allow DIRECT, MULTI, CLARIFY, and NO_MATCH.
3

Authorization / Execution

May this user invoke it now? Does risk require approval? Are arguments complete? Can the host execute safely?

Fast Pathprecision · conflict rate · unmatched raterule_conflict

System-One Decision Models: placing Jev inside the routing cascade §6.C

Jev is better understood as a typed probabilistic decision layer, not a smaller chat model. It handles predefined Noul, Choice, and Score decisions; open generation, complex planning, and multi-step reasoning remain System-Two LLM work.

FIG.6.C1 · SYSTEM-ONE + SYSTEM-TWO

Fast decisions handle closed judgments; deliberative reasoning handles open tasks

This is not a model-generation replacement story; it assigns different task shapes to different execution layers.

STATE

User / Program State

Natural language, structured business state, agent traces, or other inputs that require a decision.
SYSTEM ONE

Typed Probabilistic Decisions

Noul · Choice · Score
Returns predefined types, probabilities, and confidence for classify / route / score / gate decisions.
GATE

Confidence + Policy

High-confidence, low-risk cases can branch directly; uncertain, incomplete, or high-risk cases go to clarify, review, or escalation.
SYSTEM TWO

General LLM Planner

Open generation, compositional intents, multi-step planning, code, reports, and tasks whose answer space cannot be enumerated in advance.
CONTROL

Authorization · Validation · Host

Regardless of which model makes the decision, real side effects remain controlled by permissions, schemas, approvals, validation, and the host.
Architecture rule

Closed decision → typed probabilistic fast path. Open reasoning → general planner.

FIG.6.C2 · DECISION PRIMITIVES

Three primitives map to three programmable decision shapes

Primitive Output Best fit
NoulProbability of truth [0,1]; policy thresholds determine yes/norisk gate · condition · escalation
Choicedistribution over a defined candidate set + confidenceintent · route · capability / tool choice
Scorescale rating + level distribution + confidencequality · risk · priority · relevance
Critical boundary

Type-safe ≠ semantically correct. Staying inside the schema does not guarantee a correct business judgment; confidence calibration, fallback, slice-based evaluation, and high-risk human review are still required.

Dimension System-One / Jev-shaped General LLM / System-Two-shaped
Answer spacepredefined, typedopen text / code / plans
Core operationclassify · choose · score · gategenerate · reason · synthesize · plan
Primary advantagedirect software branching; explicit probability / confidencehigh expressive power; handles open and compositional tasks
Primary limitationcannot freely generate arbitrary contenthigher latency / cost; output freedom increases validation burden

As of 2026-09-23, Jev remains in TypeSafe early access. Its speed and cost advantages come from TypeSafe's published System-One-shaped workflow evaluations and should be treated as vendor benchmarks, not universal SLAs. Production selection should still measure accuracy, calibration, P50/P95, cost per success, and downstream task success on your own data.
